scope: complete finite original-eight adjacent-motion evidence readback

limits.input_reader: Fresh root decode and exact reconstruction of 32 RGB, 1267 gray frames, 43 tracks and 48 inputs using the pinned tracker; not an independent alternative tracker algorithm.
limits.method_reader: Independent CPU reward, weights, likelihood, motion loss, total loss and Adam reconstruction from saved summed gradients; no independent decoder autograd or second GPU model replay.
limits.metrics: Independent saved-prediction arithmetic against official scorer; maximum absolute error 1.2212453270876722e-15.
limits.motion_student: Centers are interpolated on the original source sample grid, not newly decoded on every physical frame.
limits.cohort: Eight historically exposed development sources; four per domain; no unseen confirmation or generalization claim.
limits.Source_geometry: Original Source display boxes differ from independently tracked Source pseudo-reference. Motion confidence does not establish referent identity.
